negotiation.unversioned: All three headers absent accepted during major 1; does not bypass authentication.
negotiation.duplicates: Each negotiation header exactly one; method/path must occur in installed manifest; mismatch 409 before dispatch. No wire envelope normalization between profiles.

parseProtocol.query: Any query present, even empty ?, is refused 400 by gates before admission; no filtering or duplicate query semantics because all queries rejected.
parseProtocol.body: POST: first non-ASCII-whitespace byte must be {; strict serde Wire, unknown fields/duplicate recognized fields, absent required fields, wrong type and null refused 400. Valid optional string is absent or string, not null. Content length is not relied upon: 8192-byte actual body cap, 2s to_bytes timeout. GET consumes same bounded body and requires zero bytes (whitespace also 400).

variants.when: Query, malformed JSON, invalid action combination, missing/invalid confirm or UUID or expiry, invalid storage request.

binary.semantics: No binary payload or redirects, no Set-Cookie on these lifecycle handlers. Issued.secret is JSON sensitive plaintext, not download. HEAD has no response body.

paginationFilterOrder.query: All query presence rejected for GET/POST. HEAD ignores query.
paginationFilterOrder.order: GET principals ORDER BY created_at,user_id COLLATE BINARY; each credentials ORDER BY id COLLATE BINARY. No filter/cursor/offset. LIMIT 1001 detects >1000 principals; at most 1000 credentials total across principals. Overflow/integrity failure is AUTH_UNCONFIRMED 503, not truncation. Receipt serialized <=1048576 bytes. Not applicable to action receipts/HEAD.
paginationFilterOrder.activeCount: enabled NULL counts active; expiry does not reduce count. No promise this count represents effective grants/valid credentials.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: POST confirm must be boolean true, including recover. GET no confirmation. HEAD executes no action.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision token, If-Match or optimistic version input; headers do not implement a revision check. Immediate control writer transaction provides serialization.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.currentAuthority: Human-only profile-bound signed cookie, matching workspace and verifier key; current unexpired native session. GET Current; all POST including Recover Fresh (age strictly <600000ms). Session max lifetime 43200000ms. Native current user exists, email verified, MFA enabled, exactly one verified factor, current session and latest workspace role workspace_owner; rechecked in same writer transaction.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.originCsrf: Host exactly configured authority as a single header. POST Origin required exactly configured origin; GET Origin may be absent but if present must exactly match. sec-fetch-site absent or exactly same-origin/same-site/none. Duplicate headers fail one(). No separate CSRF token input. No service-key/Bearer fallback.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.rate: GET and all four POST map to same ServiceLifecycle rate key: 10 per 60s per canonical peer. Timestamp advances on admitted attempts (cooldown), IPv4-mapped normalized; IPv6 /64 grouped; local verified Unix uid if used. Map cap 4096, mutex failure denies, retry-after:60. Auth parsed after rate and before semaphore/body. Four shared workers, permit held through blocking work even after HTTP disconnect.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.pipeline: Host lifetime/workspace admission -> application connection fence -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> non-List workspace transfer require_business_write active -> cookie_session resolve Current/Fresh -> authorize + owner role -> checked inventory/history/action -> prepared bounded receipt -> commit (List rollback). No grants supplied here; company grants/permissions are separate, and credential issuance alone is not company authorization.

key.meaning: No generic idempotency/replay key. operationId is optional caller stable correlation plus collision refusal for create/rotate/revoke, mandatory for recover; never a secret replay cache.

retry.naturalDedup: Not applicable: effect-free inventory, no operation written; repeat only with current authority and respect rate/cancellation. A cancelled superseded read must not clear a newer client session.

readBack.authority: Use currently authoritative owner session; GET /api/auth/get-session identifies session/user or null, not write outcome. GET service-principals uses serviceAccountId then credentials[].credentialId exact identity, not display name.
readBack.recovery: With caller-retained operationId POST recover confirm:true; native receipt status/recovered/serviceAccountId/credentialId/replacementCredentialId binds stable identity. Does not redisclose plaintext. Repeating create/rotate/revoke with existing operationId is 409 OPERATION_REUSED, not success replay.
readBack.absence: Inventory absence cannot prove no commit if session/role/workspace changed, snapshot failed, or principal/key not visible. Missing operation history -> 400, not an explicit HTTP not-found outcome receipt. If original omitted operationId and receipt was lost, generated operationId is lost; list has no operation IDs or secrets and no name-based safe dedup. Manual authoritative reconciliation/cancel or explicit new operation after resolution required.
readBack.oneTime: Unknown create/rotate: do not silently generate new key or replay. Recover completed only returns IDs; lost secret cannot be retrieved. Use known principal+credential with explicit fresh rotation and new operationId after reconciliation, revoke unusable exposed/unknown credential as needed. Rotation atomically disables old key on known commit; old key must not be assumed usable after unknown result.

retry.unresolvedProvider: No external provider call in current native execution: key generation, SHA-256 lookup hash, apikey rows, lifecycle events and operation history are one control transaction. Unknown commit remains unknown until reconciliation. Legacy pending/failed/recovering histories require native recovery, never infer disabled from provider failed state.

Native current user exists, email verified, MFA enabled, exactly one verified factor, current session and latest workspace role workspace_owner; rechecked in same writer transaction.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.originCsrf: Host exactly configured authority as a single header. POST Origin required exactly configured origin; GET Origin may be absent but if present must exactly match. sec-fetch-site absent or exactly same-origin/same-site/none. Duplicate headers fail one(). No separate CSRF token input. No service-key/Bearer fallback.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.rate: GET and all four POST map to same ServiceLifecycle rate key: 10 per 60s per canonical peer. Timestamp advances on admitted attempts (cooldown), IPv4-mapped normalized; IPv6 /64 grouped; local verified Unix uid if used. Map cap 4096, mutex failure denies, retry-after:60. Auth parsed after rate and before semaphore/body. Four shared workers, permit held through blocking work even after HTTP disconnect.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.pipeline: Host lifetime/workspace admission -> application connection fence -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> non-List workspace transfer require_business_write active -> cookie_session resolve Current/Fresh -> authorize + owner role -> checked inventory/history/action -> prepared bounded receipt -> commit (List rollback). No grants supplied here; company grants/permissions are separate, and credential issuance alone is not company authorization.

key.meaning: No generic idempotency/replay key. operationId is optional caller stable correlation plus collision refusal for create/rotate/revoke, mandatory for recover; never a secret replay cache.

retry.naturalDedup: Not applicable: display names are not unique identity; operationId history prevents reuse but refuses replay rather than replaying receipt. Revoke of an already disabled extant key with a new ID can append another operation.

readBack.authority: Use currently authoritative owner session; GET /api/auth/get-session identifies session/user or null, not write outcome. GET service-principals uses serviceAccountId then credentials[].credentialId exact identity, not display name.
readBack.recovery: With caller-retained operationId POST recover confirm:true; native receipt status/recovered/serviceAccountId/credentialId/replacementCredentialId binds stable identity. Does not redisclose plaintext. Repeating create/rotate/revoke with existing operationId is 409 OPERATION_REUSED, not success replay.
readBack.absence: Inventory absence cannot prove no commit if session/role/workspace changed, snapshot failed, or principal/key not visible. Missing operation history -> 400, not an explicit HTTP not-found outcome receipt. If original omitted operationId and receipt was lost, generated operationId is lost; list has no operation IDs or secrets and no name-based safe dedup. Manual authoritative reconciliation/cancel or explicit new operation after resolution required.
readBack.oneTime: Unknown create/rotate: do not silently generate new key or replay. Recover completed only returns IDs; lost secret cannot be retrieved. Use known principal+credential with explicit fresh rotation and new operationId after reconciliation, revoke unusable exposed/unknown credential as needed. Rotation atomically disables old key on known commit; old key must not be assumed usable after unknown result.

retry.unresolvedProvider: No external provider call in current native execution: key generation, SHA-256 lookup hash, apikey rows, lifecycle events and operation history are one control transaction. Unknown commit remains unknown until reconciliation. Legacy pending/failed/recovering histories require native recovery, never infer disabled from provider failed state.

installation.router: identity_router or recovery_identity_router with AuthHandlers; lifecycle routes registered whenever auth is present, independent of service_lifecycle Option. GET and POST check missing optional handler first (404 request_refused). HEAD closure does not check handler and returns 405 even if handler None.
installation.actualRuntime: Backend supplies Some native owner-backed service_lifecycle; executable merges identity router only when identity configured. Public/no connected workspace manifest does not advertise these paths; negotiated attempts then get protocol 409 before fallback. Unversioned absent-router behavior is executable /api fallback 503, not an invented lifecycle success.
installation.protocol: Outer executable protocol::install layer; constructors alone do not install this middleware.

variants.when: Only after successful native commit; issuance secret transient one-time only.
Identity router installed but service_lifecycle handler absent; before all gates.
Query present; duplicate/overlong Cookie header; malformed/invalid body or NotCommitted invalid_request.
Invalid origin/host/fetch-site, no observed peer; Unix peer mismatch if local transport middleware installed.
Authorization or x-rentemester-service-key header present (presence alone; human-only gate).

Missing/invalid signed profile cookie, no optional session, or NotCommitted invalid_credentials: expired/not fresh/current, disabled/non-owner, unverified email/MFA or session/factor authorization refusal.
Media/encoding refusal.
Shared lifecycle peer budget or rate-map capacity/lock refusal.
Four-slot capacity semaphore unavailable.
to_bytes failed.
Body timeout.
NotCommitted operation_reused: caller operationId already in history; no redisclosure.

All other native failures, poisoned owner/unavailable admission, unknown commit, task panic/join failure or invalid receipt status. This includes fence, storage integrity/bounds/clock failure, not a business-success envelope.
Installed outer protocol layer refuses partial/duplicate/stale/unsupported negotiation before dispatch.

negotiation.unversioned: All three headers absent accepted during major 1; does not bypass authentication.
negotiation.duplicates: Each negotiation header exactly one; method/path must occur in installed manifest; mismatch 409 before dispatch. No wire envelope normalization between profiles.

parseProtocol.query: Any query present, even empty ?, is refused 400 by gates before admission; no filtering or duplicate query semantics because all queries rejected.
parseProtocol.body: POST: first non-ASCII-whitespace byte must be {; strict serde Wire, unknown fields/duplicate recognized fields, absent required fields, wrong type and null refused 400. Valid optional string is absent or string, not null. Content length is not relied upon: 8192-byte actual body cap, 2s to_bytes timeout. GET consumes same bounded body and requires zero bytes (whitespace also 400).
parseProtocol.contentType: POST requires single application/json case-insensitive, parameters only charset=utf-8 (repeat allowed); any content-encoding header refused 415. GET does not require content-type but rejects any content-encoding.

variants.when: Query, malformed JSON, invalid action combination, missing/invalid confirm or UUID or expiry, invalid storage request.
to_bytes error (including oversized body).
Body read exceeds two seconds.
Unsupported content-type or any content-encoding.
Installed outer protocol layer refuses partial/duplicate/stale/unsupported negotiation before dispatch.

binary.semantics: No binary payload or redirects, no Set-Cookie on these lifecycle handlers. Issued.secret is JSON sensitive plaintext, not download. HEAD has no response body.

paginationFilterOrder.query: All query presence rejected for GET/POST. HEAD ignores query.
paginationFilterOrder.order: GET principals ORDER BY created_at,user_id COLLATE BINARY; each credentials ORDER BY id COLLATE BINARY. No filter/cursor/offset. LIMIT 1001 detects >1000 principals; at most 1000 credentials total across principals. Overflow/integrity failure is AUTH_UNCONFIRMED 503, not truncation. Receipt serialized <=1048576 bytes. Not applicable to action receipts/HEAD.
paginationFilterOrder.activeCount: enabled NULL counts active; expiry does not reduce count. No promise this count represents effective grants/valid credentials.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: POST confirm must be boolean true, including recover. GET no confirmation. HEAD executes no action.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision token, If-Match or optimistic version input; headers do not implement a revision check. Immediate control writer transaction provides serialization.
